description: Port universe + inland yards for Orient Overseas Container Line (OOCL). Keys from oocl_yards.geojson (CityYard). type is port (v3 secondary-scrape target) or inland (v3 main scrape). v3 = scrape inland, derive ports, secondary-scrape missing ports (see /synth.md). READ-ONLY: v3 only reads type. OOCL returns port names (facility Name) directly, so no location-code enrichment is needed. NOTES: (1) Portland, OR is classified inland (not a port): it is the one coastal-ish yard not in utils.PORT_NAMES, so normalize_pod would leave it bare and misalign the missing-ports diff/guard; as inland it is scraped directly and any real Portland ocean leg still derives correctly. (2) yard set has Los Angeles (no Long Beach) and Seattle (no Tacoma); normalize_pod keeps each pair distinct, so any Long Beach/Tacoma voyages appear only as derive-only distinct discharge ports (never queried), like HPL Long Beach. [v2 copy — independent from v3 coverage.json. 12 ports; flat mapping.json (no nested keys), so co-located Long Beach/Tacoma/Port Everglades are not queried separately.]
